name: Larsen Thompson
biography: Dancer, model, and actress who first gained attention as a dancer in a viral video for Beyonce's song "Run the World (Girls)." Has appeared in music videos by Borns, Pink and Katy Perry, also has been a backup dancer for Janet Jackson, Christina Aguilera and Silento. As a model, she was featured in The New York Times, Harper's Bazaar and Forbes and has worked with brands like Dior, Fendi, Puma and Marc Jacobs.
movies: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge on the Run
